label: Morning Brief
timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary.

driver.text: Per WSJ, stock futures fell ahead of a pivotal week for the AI trade, with Nvidia earnings due Tuesday and Anthropic's public listing expected, after fresh weakness in Asian AI stocks (4:43 AM ET). WSJ also reported Asian equities dropped as Friday's U.S. chip selloff spilled over, led by Taiwan's Taiex (1:16 AM ET), and that U.S. Treasury yields declined while Fed rate-hike prospects stayed in focus (5:03 AM ET). Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

calendar.text: Nvidia is due to report earnings, per WSJ, amid its CEO leadership change.
Anthropic's public listing is expected, per WSJ.
A slate of Federal Reserve speeches and the central bank's most recent meeting minutes are due, per Bloomberg.

cryptoDriver.text: Per CoinDesk, Bitcoin slipped after rebounding from a low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations over the weekend. Written from the headline only.

items.headline: The Campaign to Bring Back Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: Per WSJ, in open letters, phone calls and group chats, Huang's allies are making the case that his ouster was hasty, even as legal scrutiny intensifies. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Nvidia’s Days as an Open Checkbook for the AI Economy Are Numbered
items.summary: Per WSJ, interim CEO Colette Kress is expected to rein in deals after a stretch in which Nvidia aggressively financed computing deals and startup investments. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Trump Administration to Name Nvidia Among AI 'National Champions'
items.summary: Per WSJ, the new program is part of an effort to help U.S. AI companies compete for business overseas. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.
